headline: High: shared filesystem writes and broad egress create default risks of prompt injection, data leakage, and cascading errors between marketingskills and slim.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: marketingskills reads and writes shared skill files and its sandboxing says skills “reference each other and build on shared context”; slim also reads/writes filesystem and uses interactive command execution. That creates a plausible default path where content from one can be treated as instructions by the other, though no direct bridge is documented.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same workspace or skill directory
IF slim ingests files produced by marketingskills as instructions or commands
mitigations: Separate workspaces per agent
Disable automatic parsing of peer-generated files
Add provenance labels to shared artifacts
Review any file-based handoff before execution
requires-engineering: add isolation or mediation layer

B_data_leakage.rationale: marketingskills touches marketing content and product marketing context, while slim touches filesystem artifacts, environment variables, certificate private keys, and registry credentials. Both have filesystem access and network egress, so a shared workspace could expose sensitive artifacts from slim into marketingskills outputs or vice versa.
conditions: IF both agents share a filesystem or mounted workspace
IF slim processes secrets or certificate files in the same directory marketingskills can read
mitigations: Use separate mounts for each agent
Redact secrets before any handoff
Restrict marketingskills to non-sensitive folders
Audit outputs for leaked paths or values
requires-engineering: enforce per-agent access controls

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Both agents can write the filesystem and spawn subprocesses; marketingskills also supports multiple instances, while slim is single-session and writes container artifacts. If they share a directory, concurrent writes can corrupt files or overwrite each other, and slim’s broader execution surface increases the blast radius.
conditions: IF both agents write to the same directory or repo
IF marketingskills runs multiple instances against slim-managed artifacts
mitigations: Assign disjoint output directories
Serialize writes with a lock file
Run one agent at a time on shared artifacts
Snapshot before each write step
requires-engineering: add transactional workspace coordination

D_cascading_error.rationale: marketingskills is designed so skills build on shared context, and slim is an interactive CLI that executes commands. If slim consumes marketingskills output without verification, a mistaken marketing claim or malformed instruction can cascade into incorrect container actions or artifact changes.
conditions: IF slim treats marketingskills output as authoritative
IF marketingskills emits malformed or stale guidance into a shared file
mitigations: Insert a human review step
Require schema validation on handoff files
Compare outputs against source artifacts
Limit slim to dry-run mode for first pass
requires-engineering: add verification gates between agents

E_compliance.rationale: slim explicitly handles certificate private keys, registry credentials, and environment variables, while marketingskills is a marketing-content agent with filesystem access. If both operate on the same regulated workspace, retention or residency controls can diverge and create compliance gaps; the profiles do not show a shared compliance regime.
conditions: IF regulated secrets or personal data are stored in the shared workspace
IF retention or deletion policies differ between the two agents
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of shared folders
Document retention for each agent
Separate secret-handling runs from marketing runs
Review logs for sensitive fields
requires-engineering: align policy enforcement across agents
